messages:
maria: quick heads-up — qbringup-v2-int4 shows a weird spike vs golden on promptset X, ~6.4% label-disagreement on intent classification :eyes:

aj: ugh. is that across all buckets or localized?

maria: mostly long-form how-to + code-block prompts. attaching quick diff snapshot:
```
Metric         baseline   qbringup-int4   delta
exact_match    0.912      0.847           -0.065
intent_agree   0.981      0.917           -0.064
``` 

sam: can you share the failing examples? maybe tokenizer or truncation issue.

maria: pasted 4 examples below (shortened). note the ones with inline `<code>` and long backticks get trimmed.
1) "How to set env var in zsh with spaces"
2) "Refactor: split monolith into services — code sample included"
3) "SQL: why join order matters"
4) "Edge: yaml with anchors causes bad tokenization"

nina: quick thought — we rolled tokenizer v2 last week for the model bridge. could be tokenization mismatch causing paraphrase collapse.

kevin: label ops here. if we need relabel, I can spin a 150-sample golden batch. timeline? we can do a 24h micro-sprint.

maria: yes please, let's get a golden relabel for the 150 highest-delta samples. also need dedupe run because many paraphrases are near-duplicates.

label-bot: @kevin created relabel batch `golden_q4_int4_5249` with 150 items. Link: https://labeler/gold/golden_q4_int4_5249 :white_check_mark:

kevin: thanks. @ella and @tom will take first pass. ops: please freeze canary for qbringup-v2-int4 until we get relabel results.

ops-bot: Canary freeze applied for `qbringup-v2-int4` on us-west-2. Automatic rollback rule enabled.

sam: small eval script to rerun local scoring against updated tokenization:
```
python tools/eval_diff.py --model qbringup-v2-int4 \
  --prompts data/edge_150.json --tokenizer tokenizers/v2
```

maria: adding seed filter regex to the sampling to avoid near-identical paraphrases: `^(?!.*\b(example|demo)\b).{20,}` — will exclude tiny demo prompts.

nina: good. also add `preserve_backticks: true` flag in preproc for that batch.

kevin: relabelers assigned. I'll sync daily. @maria can you open a small canary rerun ticket with results post-relab?

maria: on it. will post results here and a quick diff table. thx all :wave:

ella: acknowledged — starting relabel now.
